Basic Auto Body Repair

ABDY 113:

5.0 Units

Prerequisite: Completion of ABDY 112
A continuation of ABDY 112 with instruction and practice in resistance and Metal Inert Gas (MIG) welding on automotive panels; panel replacement and alignment; servicing vehicle doors and door glass; modern auto body construction. (AVC)
